description: What happened in the Canton Dev Fund lately, newest first: new comments and reviews with a snippet, and (optionally) timeline events such as labels added, reviewers requested, proposals renamed, merged, closed or moved on the project board. Use for "what is going on in the Dev Fund", "what did the committee say this week", "which proposals just got reviewed". Canton-specific.

days.description: Look back this many days. Default 7, max 120.

include_events.description: Also list timeline events (labels, reviewer requests, renames, board moves). Default true.

offset.description: Skip this many entries, for paging.

name: get_dev_fund_activity
